random.label: Random model
random.note: Each dot is one uniform random Motzkin tree, with the same complexity as one Feynman expression in the branch plots. Operator labels are drawn uniformly from the counting alphabet.

note: Each dot is one expression. The x-axis is its complexity. β is the log-least-squares estimate: rank the operator types by how often they occur, and β minimises the sum over ranks of (log f_r − log p_r)^2, where f_r is the observed frequency and p_r = exp(−β r) / sum_s exp(−β s). Each rank is one residual. The horizontal line is the same fit after every expression's operator counts in that corpus are added together and ranked once. Feynman and Inflationaris are the released formulas. Wikipedia adds the algebraic extension after Doppler. f(R) is the expressions held in that corpus.
